fact: Human Rights Watch says that on 1 November 2024 the Mauritius communications authority directed internet service providers to suspend access to all social media platforms until after the 10 November elections, and the government rescinded the ban a day later.
Human Rights Watch says the social media ban drew swift and widespread outcry from the business community, civil society and opposition politicians inside Mauritius.
